name: How long does it take to build a casita from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a casita from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for casita construction typically ranges from 4 to 8 months, depending on the project's scope, permitting process, and material availability. Design and permitting can take 1-3 months. Construction itself usually takes 3-5 months for a standard project. Unexpected delays due to weather, inspections, or material delivery can extend this timeframe. A clear project plan and schedule will be provided once designs are finalized.
acceptedAnswer.description: Building a casita typically takes 4 to 8 months, including design, permitting, and construction. This can vary based on project scope and unforeseen delays.
